user_query: I'm hosting a cryptocurrency conference and I need to showcase the global impact of cryptocurrencies. Can you provide me with the global statistics on cryptocurrency from the Coinranking API? Additionally, fetch the currency conversions historical rates for a particular timeframe using the CurrencyAPI.net API to demonstrate the historical growth of cryptocurrencies.

TaskList.description: Fetch global statistics on cryptocurrency from the Coinranking API to understand its overall impact and current status.
Fetch historical currency conversion rates for a selected timeframe using the CurrencyAPI.net API to show the historical growth trends of cryptocurrencies.
